structuredContent.body:
Adopt the published Builds 4.44.2 / Platform v1.3.0 tuple for blocking disposable package integration, using immutable Builds executor `ae68c59bd2f4145a23ccf68c3711f98eaf62195f` in ordinary CI and the registered lifecycle baseline. Preserve all 15 isolated projects, independent owner gates, incoming source selections, publication controls and existing budgets.

Enable the exact Memories 3.0.23 refresh and FrontComposer 4.7.6 UI/readiness capabilities in the owning finite selectors. Keep unknown-package fallbacks and strict served-asset identity checks. The native suite retains real Parties/Tenants/Memories persistence assertions, adds anonymous gateway 401 coverage and preserves bounded source/owner-bound SDK diagnostics.

Validation on the final correction: 449 affected .NET cases and 68 single-attempt package browser cases passed with zero failures/skips/flakes. TypeScript, browser configuration, restored assets and strict declaration controls passed; affected Release/package builds completed with zero warnings/errors. Finite selector tests preserve earlier supported versions and reject unknown versions.

The first hosted run of the adopted tuple is retained: its unconditional capability test correctly stopped provisioning, and its UI package guard failed. These owning selector/guard defects are corrected here. Full new-source hosted CI, real all-owner native execution with retained reports and exact cleanup, and the three manual lifecycle scenarios remain required. The new 401 fact has compiled locally and requires genuine hosted execution. No historical parity or candidate acceptance is claimed.
